items.name: Context7 Docs
items.description: Up-to-date library documentation and code examples for thousands of packages. No sign-in needed.

items.name: Playwright (browser)
items.description: Drive a real browser: navigate, click, type, screenshot and scrape web pages. Install only one browser connector at a time.

items.name: Chrome DevTools (browser)
items.description: Google's Chrome automation for bots: reliable click/type/navigate with built-in waits, plus console, network and performance inspection. No sign-in needed. Install only one browser connector at a time.

items.name: Agent Browser (browser)
items.description: Vercel's agent-first browser as a connector: real headed Chrome, accessibility snapshots with clickable refs, wait-on-condition helpers, a fast read-only mode for pages, and a persistent profile so logins survive restarts. Pinned to a verified version. Install only one browser connector at a time.

items.name: Filesystem (workspace)
items.description: Read and write files in the workspace through tools instead of shell commands.

items.name: Memory (knowledge graph)
items.description: A persistent knowledge graph the bot can save to and recall across chats.

items.name: Sequential Thinking
items.description: Structured step-by-step reasoning for multi-step problems.

items.name: Everything (reference)
items.description: The reference MCP server: demo tools, prompts and resources. Handy for testing.

items.name: GitHub
items.description: Repos, issues, pull requests and code search through GitHub's hosted MCP server.

fields.label: GitHub personal access token
fields.help: Stored in your workspace opencode.jsonc. Needs repo scope (classic) or equivalent fine-grained access.

items.name: Slack
items.description: Search messages and files, read channels and reply as you through Slack's official connector. A workspace admin may need to approve it first.

items.name: Gmail
items.description: Search, read, label and draft mail through Google's official Gmail connector (developer preview). Read and draft only: the server has no send tool.

mcp.note: Needs a one-time Google Cloud OAuth client: add its ID and secret to .env, then choose Sign in. The README walks through the 5-minute setup.

items.name: Google Chat
items.description: Search and read your spaces and send messages through Google's official Chat connector (developer preview).

mcp.note: Uses the same one-time Google Cloud OAuth client as Gmail, with http://127.0.0.1:19877/callback added as a redirect URI. The README walks through it.

items.name: Microsoft Teams
items.description: Read teams, channels and chats, send messages, share files and search across Microsoft Teams through the Graph API.

items.name: Discord
items.description: Read channels, send and manage messages, threads, forums, reactions and webhooks in your Discord server.

fields.label: Discord bot token
fields.placeholder: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal
fields.help: Create a bot at discord.com/developers/applications, enable the Message Content intent, then invite it to your server. Stored in your workspace opencode.jsonc.

items.name: Sentry
items.description: Search issues, events and stack traces. Requires a browser sign-in after install.

items.name: Models Discovery
items.description: Auto-discovers OpenAI-compatible models from local providers and dynamic gateways.

items.name: DCP: context pruning
items.description: Prunes obsolete tool output from the conversation to save context tokens.

items.name: Langfuse Observability
items.description: Sends session traces and usage to your Langfuse project for observability.

items.name: Release notes
items.description: Draft a changelog or release notes from git history.

items.name: Meeting notes
items.description: Turn raw notes or transcripts into decisions, action items and open questions.

items.name: Research brief
items.description: Compile a sourced, decision-ready brief on any topic.

items.name: Browser craft
items.description: How to browse fast and accurately: one block per flow, extract with expressions, wait on conditions, never loop.
